description: This file contains functions and types for applying secret configurations, including plan resolution, environment variable scrubbing, file snapshot management, and execution of secret application with dry-run and write modes.

methods.name: planContainsExecReferences
methods.description: Checks if the secrets plan contains references to 'exec' source, indicating execution dependencies.

methods.name: resolveTarget
methods.description: Resolves a secrets plan target to its validated form, throwing an error if invalid.

methods.name: scrubEnvRaw
methods.description: Removes migrated environment variable values from raw env string based on allowed keys.

methods.name: applyProviderPlanMutations
methods.description: Applies upsert and delete mutations to the provider configurations within the main config.

methods.name: projectPlanState
methods.description: Projects the current secrets plan into a new state, applying mutations, scrubbing, and validation.

methods.name: applyConfigTargetMutations
methods.description: Resolves and applies mutations to configuration targets, tracking changes and provider shadowing.

methods.name: scrubAuthStoresForProviderTargets
methods.description: Scrubs sensitive data from auth stores associated with provider targets, adding warnings as needed.

methods.name: ensureMutableAuthStore
methods.description: Ensures an auth store object is mutable, initializing version and profiles if missing.

methods.name: resolveAuthStoreForTarget
methods.description: Resolves and loads the auth store for a specific secrets plan target.

methods.name: asConfigPathRoot
methods.description: Casts an auth store to a config path root type.

methods.name: resolveAuthStorePathForAgent
methods.description: Constructs the path to an agent's auth profile store based on configuration.

methods.name: ensureAuthProfileContainer
methods.description: Ensures an auth profile container exists and matches expected type, creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: applyAuthProfileTargetMutation
methods.description: Applies mutations to auth profile targets, including sibling references and ref updates.

methods.name: scrubLegacyAuthJsonStores
methods.description: Removes sensitive data from legacy auth JSON files.

methods.name: scrubEnvFiles
methods.description: Scrubs environment variable files of secret values based on scrubbed set.

methods.name: validateProjectedSecretsState
methods.description: Validates the projected secrets state, resolving secret references and preparing runtime snapshots.

methods.name: captureFileSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of a file's existence, content, and mode.

methods.name: restoreFileSnapshot
methods.description: Restores a file from a previously captured snapshot.

methods.name: toJsonWrite
methods.description: Creates an ApplyWrite object for writing JSON content to a file.

methods.name: runSecretsApply
methods.description: Main function to perform secrets application, supporting dry-run and actual write modes, with validation and error handling.
